title: Electrician Apprentice Hours
short: A production-grade Flutter app for electrician apprentices to log apprenticeship hours, featuring six real NEC engineering calculators with LLM-powered voice input, and a dual Firebase/SQLite backend architecture.
description:
⚡ Electrician Apprentice Hours

Electrician Apprentice Hours replaces spreadsheets and paper logs with a native mobile experience for electricians tracking thousands of hours toward their journeyman license. Beyond hour and employer tracking, the app ships six real NEC (National Electrical Code) engineering calculators and an LLM-powered voice input pipeline — say "150 feet, 20 amps, copper, 240 volts" and the app parses your speech and fills the calculator for you.

📈 Why It Stands Out

🎙️ Voice
LLM-Powered Calculators
🍏 Live
Shipped on the App Store
⚡ NEC
6 Real Engineering Calculators
🔐 Signed
HMAC-Secured API Pipeline

🔢 Real NEC Electrical Engineering

Six working calculators implement actual NEC tables — not toy math. The core calculator engine alone runs 1,345 lines of hand-verified domain logic.

📉Voltage Drop, Max Circuit Distance, Load Calculator (Article 220)
⚙️Motor Circuit calculator across 4 motor types (Article 430)
🔌Circuit Calculations and Conduit Fill (Chapter 9, Tables 4/5)
🎙️LLM-powered voice input — on-device speech-to-text feeds an NLP model that extracts fields and auto-fills any calculator

🏗️ Engineering Highlights

🏛️Clean Architecture, enforced — strict UI → Bloc → UseCase → AbstractRepository flow, domain layer 100% pure Dart
🔐HMAC-SHA256 signed voice API — request body signed against the exact serialized byte string to prevent signature drift, plus Firebase ID-token bearer auth
🗄️Two independent backends — Firebase Auth/Firestore for accounts, local SQLite (froom/floor) for hours and employers, with atomic dual-writes
📱True adaptive UI — Cupertino on iOS, Material on Android, routed through a platform-abstraction layer plus a tablet NavigationRail breakpoint
🩺Production error observability — Firebase Crashlytics wired at global FlutterError.onError/PlatformDispatcher.onError level and inside every repository call
🐛Debugged a real device-fabric bug — traced daily-reminder notifications silently drifting to UTC on some Android devices to a stripped legacy Olson timezone alias, fixed via latest_all.dart

🚀 Impact

Electrician Apprentice Hours is a live App Store product demonstrating LLM-powered voice UX, enforced Clean Architecture at scale, real dual-backend engineering, subtle security-correctness problem solving, and true platform-adaptive UI — all delivered solo end-to-end.
features: Full CRUD hour logging and history backed by SQLite, employer-linked, with entry detail edit/delete.

Six real NEC engineering calculators — Voltage Drop, Max Circuit Distance, Load Calculator (Art. 220), Motor Circuit (Art. 430, 4 motor types), Circuit Calculations, Conduit Fill (Ch. 9 Tables 4/5) — hand-verified against authoritative sources.
LLM-powered voice input pipeline — on-device speech-to-text feeding a signed REST API with LLM-based field extraction that auto-fills any calculator.
HMAC-SHA256 request signing against the exact serialized byte string (not re-serialized by the HTTP client) to prevent signature drift, plus Firebase ID-token bearer auth.
Two independent, correctly-wired data backends — Firebase Auth (Google + Apple Sign-In) + Firestore for accounts, local SQLite via froom/floor for hours and employers, with atomic dual-writes.
Clean Architecture enforced across 18 features — identical bloc/event/state triad, domain layer with zero Firebase/Flutter imports, Either<Failure, T> error handling via a shared guard() helper.
True adaptive UI — AdaptiveScaffold, action sheets, and wheel pickers routed to Cupertino on iOS and Material on Android, plus a tablet-width NavigationRail breakpoint.
Production error observability — Firebase Crashlytics wired at global FlutterError.onError/PlatformDispatcher.onError level and inside every repository call.
Dashboard with progress ring toward journeyman hour target, streaks, and tool shortcuts.

Daily reminder notifications via flutter_local_notifications + timezone, Doze/App-Standby-aware exact vs. inexact scheduling — including a fixed legacy Olson timezone alias bug (e.g. Dhaka as Asia/Dacca).
PDF/CSV export scaffolding using pdf, printing, and share_plus.
get_it + injectable dependency injection, fully code-generated, zero manual service-locator wiring.

title: Mili
short: A Uber/Grab/Gojek-style on-demand marketplace platform built with Flutter, featuring real-time WebSocket bidding, live GPS trip tracking, and dual customer/driver experiences across nine service verticals.
description:
🚗 Mili: Multi-Service On-Demand Marketplace

Mili is a production-scale super-app connecting customers with drivers in real time across nine on-demand service verticals — moto rides, car rides, city-to-city trips, moving, errands, pickup & delivery, repair & services, big-item transport, and line-waiting/helper services. Built solo as a single Flutter codebase serving two distinct clients, the platform centers on a live competitive bidding marketplace where drivers bid on posted jobs and customers track the winning driver in real time from pickup to drop-off.

📈 Key Stats

9
Service Verticals
WebSocket
Live Bidding Engine
Live Map
GPS Trip Tracking
2 Apps
Customer + Driver, 1 Codebase

⚡ Live Bidding Marketplace

Built a custom real-time bidding engine on a persistent WebSocket connection — customers post a job, nearby drivers compete with live bid offers, and the winning driver is tracked live on a Google Map from pickup to drop-off.

📡Custom WebSocket service with auto-reconnect and handshake/stability checks
🔄6+ live event streams: job alerts, bids, bid status, chat, live location
🗺️Live driver tracking with polyline route rendering
💬In-app chat and push notifications throughout the trip lifecycle

🏗️ Engineering Highlights

🏛️Clean Architecture — strict presentation/domain/data layering across 18+ feature modules
🧩~200 Riverpod providers with code generation (`@riverpod`) replacing manual setState/Bloc boilerplate
🔒Either<Failure, T> error handling (dartz-style) with Freezed immutable models/unions
👥Dual-role experience — one codebase serving distinct Customer and Driver clients
🌐Internationalization-ready — English/Spanish via Flutter's intl/ARB pipeline

🚀 Impact

Mili demonstrates the ability to design and deliver a genuinely complex, multi-domain product solo at high velocity — combining real-time systems engineering, scalable Clean Architecture, and production-grade mapping into a single cohesive marketplace platform.
features: Real-time bidding marketplace — customers post jobs, nearby drivers compete with live bid offers over WebSocket, customers accept and track the winning driver on a live map.
Custom WebSocket service with auto-reconnect, handshake/stability checks, and broadcast stream controllers driving 6+ real-time event types.
Two apps, one codebase — fully-branched Customer/Driver experience sharing a single domain and data layer while keeping role-specific UX distinct.
Live GPS trip tracking with Google Maps polyline route rendering, geolocation/geocoding, and time-throttled location updates.
Clean Architecture with strict presentation → domain → data layering across 18+ feature modules covering 9 service verticals.
Riverpod code-generation (@riverpod) across ~200 feature-scoped providers for typed, testable, auto-disposing state.
Freezed + json_serializable immutable models across bid, chat, job, listing, live-location, notification, and profile domains.
24 generated Retrofit/Dio REST API services plus a custom Result/Either wrapper for typed success/failure handling.
Full auth & trust surface — phone/OTP verification, Google Sign-In, flutter_secure_storage, and profile-completion gating.
go_router with auth/profile-based redirects and role-aware navigation between Customer and Driver flows.
Firebase Cloud Messaging push notifications and in-app chat (per-role conversation + message screens) with a notification center.
Internationalization via Flutter's intl/ARB pipeline supporting English and Spanish from day one.

title: Blood Setu
short: A real-time blood donation matching platform built with Flutter and Firebase, featuring geohash-based donor discovery, live chat with presence tracking, and a full Clean Architecture BLoC pattern.
description:
🩸 Blood Setu: Real-Time Blood Donation Platform

Blood Setu is a production-scale mobile application that connects blood donors with recipients across Bangladesh in real time. The platform was built to solve complex challenges around geolocation search, real-time communication, scalability, and performance while helping users find compatible donors during emergencies.

📈 Key Results

1477+
Donors Tested
100%
Reachability
94%
Fewer Reads
33×
Faster Search

📍 Smart Donor Discovery

Designed a custom geolocation search system that progressively expands the search area until enough matching donors are found. Instead of loading thousands of records at once, the platform prioritizes nearby donors and streams results as they become available.

⚡First donor results appear in ~300ms
🎯Prioritizes the nearest compatible donors
💾Intelligent caching for repeat searches
🌍Scales efficiently with large donor datasets

💬 Real-Time Communication

Built a complete real-time messaging system that allows donors and recipients to coordinate instantly during emergencies.

🟢Online / Offline Presence
⌨️Live Typing Indicators
📩Instant Message Synchronization
👀Last-Seen Tracking
🔔Unread Message Counts

🏗️ Engineering Highlights

🏛️Clean Architecture with strict separation of concerns
🧩Feature-Based Modular Design for maintainability and scalability
🔒Atomic Transactions for data consistency
📄Advanced Pagination & Search Strategies
🔄Real-Time Synchronization across multiple services

🚑 Impact

Blood Setu demonstrates the ability to design and build a scalable production-ready application that solves a meaningful social problem while handling complex challenges in geospatial search, performance optimization, real-time systems, and large-scale data management.
features: Geohash radius-ring pagination for nearby donor discovery — progressive radius expansion with per-blood-group caching to minimize redundant Firestore reads.
Real-time 1-to-1 chat using concurrent Firestore (messages) and Firebase RTDB (presence + typing) stream subscriptions with optimistic send and auto mark-as-read.
Cursor-based infinite scroll pagination for blood requests with live search and compound blood group + urgency filters.
Atomic Firestore batch writes and transactions — interest registration, donation recording, and profile updates across denormalized collections with guaranteed consistency.
Clean Architecture with BLoC + Freezed sealed unions, repository pattern, and use-case layer decoupled from all Firebase dependencies.
GoRouter declarative navigation with ChangeNotifier-based auth refresh guard — auth state changes automatically re-evaluate redirect rules.
GetIt + injectable DI with build_runner code generation — all BLoCs, repositories, and services resolved via the service locator.
Dual-write denormalization at registration and profile edit — atomically updates both profile/{uid} and a geo-queryable user_locations/{uid} collection in one batch.
PDF donation certificate generation with dynamic image asset embedding and native share sheet via the printing package.
OpenStreetMap tile-based interactive location picker with debounced reverse geocoding and named-record return type.

title: Farmer Assistance Backend
short: A FastAPI backend for smart farming with crop disease detection, AI chat, irrigation prediction, and market price forecasting using ML models.
description: Farmer Assistance Backend is a modular FastAPI server designed for a Flutter/mobile client that empowers farmers with AI and machine learning tools. It provides crop disease detection from image uploads using a TensorFlow CNN model with Grad-CAM heatmap visualization, an AI farming chatbot powered by RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) using Gemini and sentence-transformers, smart irrigation prediction, fertilizer recommendation, crop recommendation, crop yield estimation, and commodity price prediction. Authentication is handled via Supabase JWT, and all data is stored and retrieved through Supabase database and storage. Each prediction domain follows a clean modular architecture with dedicated routers, schemas, and services.
features: Crop disease detection from image uploads using TensorFlow CNN with Grad-CAM heatmap visualization.
AI farming chatbot with RAG pipeline using Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash) and sentence-transformers.
Persistent multi-turn conversation system with auto-generated titles and Q&A pairing.
Smart irrigation prediction based on crop, soil type, growth stage, moisture, temperature, and humidity.
Fertilizer recommendation based on crop, soil color, and soil nutrients (N, P, K, pH, rainfall).
Crop recommendation using classification model with soil and climate inputs.
Crop yield estimation using regression model with area, rainfall, temperature, and pesticide data.
Commodity price prediction using XGBoost with location, market, and seasonal features.
Secure JWT-based authentication via Supabase with JWKS validation.
Modular Clean Architecture with lazy-loaded ML model assets and Supabase storage integration.

title: AI-Powered Smart Farming Assistant (Group Project)
short: An AI-based smart farming app with disease detection, crop recommendation, and predictive analytics using machine learning.
description: AI-Powered Smart Farming Assistant is a Flutter-based cross-platform application designed to help farmers make data-driven decisions using Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. The app provides crop disease detection using CNN, smart irrigation, fertilizer recommendation, crop recommendation, yield estimation, and market price forecasting through ML models. It integrates external APIs for real-time weather insights and uses Supabase for authentication and cloud data management. The system follows Clean Architecture principles, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and modular development. Additionally, an AI chatbot offers real-time assistance to farmers. This is a collaborative group project and is currently 90% completed.
features: Crop disease detection using CNN and image processing.
Smart irrigation system powered by machine learning.
Fertilizer recommendation based on soil nutrients (N, P, K, pH).
Crop recommendation system using classification models.
Crop yield estimation using regression models.
Market price forecasting using machine learning.
Real-time weather forecasting using external APIs.
AI chatbot for real-time farming assistance.
Secure authentication and cloud database using Supabase.
Scalable and modular design using Clean Architecture.

title: Finance Tracker — Manage Your Money Effortlessly
short: A personal finance management app built with Flutter to track income, expenses, and analytics.
description: Finance Tracker is a Flutter-based mobile application that helps users manage their daily finances efficiently. Users can add income and expenses, categorize transactions, view analytics (daily, monthly, yearly), track savings goals, and monitor spending habits through visual charts. The app stores all data locally, ensuring privacy and offline access.
features: Track income and expenses with flexible category management.
Visualize daily, monthly, and yearly analytics with charts.
Set savings goals and monitor spending habits offline.

title: NamidVault — Secure Document Vault App (Client Project)
short: Secure PDF storage app with expiry tracking, push notifications, and Emergency Access feature.
description: Client Project: Built a secure PDF storage and document vault application. Implemented expiry date tracking with push notifications, Emergency Access feature for urgent retrieval, and developed a clean, modern UI from scratch. Integrated Firebase Auth and Firestore with strong structural design. Delivered bug-free final product using Clean Architecture and GetIt DI.

title: DeenHub App
short: All-in-one Islamic app with 35k+ Hadith, prayer times, daily duas, Tasbih counter, Hijri calendar, and 99 Names of Allah.
description: Group Project (January 2025 - March 2025): DeenHub is an all-in-one Islamic app offering 35,000+ Hadith, location-based prayer times, daily duas, a Tasbih counter, Hijri calendar, and more. Users can bookmark Hadiths, track dhikr, and explore the 99 Names of Allah to enhance their spiritual journey. Available on Google Play Store. Developed key features: Hadith collection, 6 Dhikr Tasbih counter, and location-based prayer times. Implemented Clean Architecture and used Flutter Bloc for state management. Integrated GetIt for dependency injection, improving maintainability and scalability. Used SQLite (Floor package) for local data storage and optimized database queries. Implemented SharedPreferences to store Tasbih progress and last location for prayer times. Managed HUAWEI AppGallery & Amazon Appstore, handling compliance, updates, and app maintenance.
features: Browse 35,000+ Hadith with bookmarking support.
Access prayer times based on user location.
Use Tasbih counter, Hijri calendar, and daily duas in one app.

title: English Booster
short: Vocabulary learning app with swipe cards, spaced repetition, and progress tracking.
description: Vocabulary learning app with swipe cards, spaced repetition, and progress tracking. Uses SQLite for offline data and Flutter Bloc for scalable state management.
features: Practice words with swipe-based flashcards.
Improve retention using spaced repetition.
Track learning progress with offline-first storage.

title: Secure File Vault — Encrypted Document Storage
short: A secure Flutter app for encrypted file storage using custom Snake Matrix XOR encryption.
description: Secure File Vault is a Flutter-based application designed for secure document storage with end-to-end encryption. Files are encrypted locally using a custom Snake Matrix XOR algorithm with a randomly generated key, which is further secured using RSA encryption. The app integrates Firebase for authentication, storage, and metadata management, while ensuring all files remain encrypted before upload. ZLib compression is used to optimize performance, and Flutter Isolates handle heavy processing to keep the UI smooth. The project focuses on privacy, performance, and scalable architecture.
features: End-to-end file encryption before upload
Custom Snake Matrix XOR encryption algorithm
RSA-based secure key encryption
Firebase Authentication (Google Sign-In)
Secure file storage with Firebase Storage
Metadata management using Firestore
ZLib compression for optimized performance
Secure key storage using Flutter SecureStorage
Support for multiple file types (PDF, images, etc.)
Smooth performance using Flutter Isolates

title: Flutter News App
short: A fully functional news application with REST API, Firebase Auth, SQLite offline storage, and Clean Architecture.
description: Project (January 2024 - March 2024): A fully functional news application developed using Flutter, integrating a REST API, Firebase Authentication, SQLite offline storage, Flutter Bloc, and Clean Architecture for maintainable and scalable code. Features include: Real-Time News Feed fetching articles from a RESTful API, Firebase Authentication for secure login, Offline Support with SQLite (automatically saves fetched news articles and displays them when offline), State Management using Flutter Bloc for predictable state handling, Clean Architecture with domain, data, and presentation layers for scalable and testable codebase, and Dark Mode Support with seamless theme switching.
features: Fetch and display real-time news from a REST API.
Provide secure login with Firebase Authentication.
Support offline reading with SQLite article caching.
